rec.name: Collection Product Card Image Slider (CP Product Slider)
rec.status: Built — launched (documented; infinite-swipe idea logged for v1.1)

what.text: A swipeable image carousel inside each product card of a product grid (primarily collection pages). Shoppers can browse 1 to 5 product images per card (e.g. front, back, detail, on-model) without opening the PDP. Navigation uses dots (bottom left or bottom right) and/or arrows with a configurable colour. Mobile and desktop can be switched on or off and styled separately. Dots sit below or beside the image rather than over it. The slider also applies to every grid that uses the product card: home, collection, product page recommendations and search results.

why.text: On a listing page, one static image forces a click to the PDP to see more. Letting shoppers see more angles in place lowers the effort needed to judge a product, which reduces uncertainty and speeds up decisions. It also increases engagement with the product card, which signals interest. Showing back, detail and on-model shots in the grid works like a quick-look and supports fashion/apparel where fit and look matter. Dots show that more images exist (progressive disclosure). Keeping dots off the image avoids visibility problems on busy or colored backgrounds.

how.text: 1) Add a 'CP product slider' group to config/settings_schema.json with the settings listed below. 2) Create the snippet cp-product-slider.liquid. It loops over product.images (limit = image count setting) and outputs lazy-loaded images with responsive widths and a 0.8 aspect ratio inside a Flickity container. The snippet also holds the CSS: dot and arrow styling, and mobile (<1000px) vs desktop (>=1000px) media queries that hide the original static image and show the slider. 3) Add a cpProductSlider() function to assets/custom.js that initialises Flickity only when a card has more than one image (config: adaptiveHeight, dragThreshold 10, contain, pageDots, prevNextButtons). 4) Render the snippet inside .product-item__image-wrapper in product-item.liquid. 5) Load Flickity CSS and JS in theme.liquid head (the ticket uses the unpkg CDN). Pagespeed must not suffer: images are lazy-loaded and the slider only initialises when there are 2 or more images. Because the code touches theme files, non-developers cannot install it.

items: Mobile: dots position (bottom left / bottom right)
Desktop: dots position (bottom left / bottom right)

dependencies.text: Theme edit access (settings_schema.json, product-item.liquid, theme.liquid, custom.js); not installable by non-developers. Needs the Flickity 2 library (CDN in the ticket; could be self-hosted for performance). Theme assumptions: product card uses the classes .product-item__image-wrapper and .product-item__aspect-ratio, and products have multiple images. No product metafields are required (ticket field says 'MF/N'). The ticket also notes the change affects every Product Grid section. Known gap: no infinite or looping swipe yet (planned for v1.1).

items: Collection page to PDP click-through rate
Conversion rate and revenue per session on collection pages
Collection page speed (LCP, CLS) to check there is no regression
Return rate (if better image previews reduce wrong-size/look purchases)

images.caption: Pegador reference: product grid cards with dots at bottom left of the image (filled = active), next to the quick-add bag icon
3rd May reference: slider cards with white arrows left/right on the image, with badge, title and color swatches below
Shopify theme editor: 'CP product slider' settings, with image count and separate Mobile/Desktop show, dots, dots position and arrow colour
Final dots design: dots sit under the image, not over it, so background colours cannot hide them
Live collection grid: card with an active slide, round arrows and dots under the image, with sale badge and price below
